label: Share of travel venture funding going to AI-enabled startups
question: Where is travel technology investment going?
answer: 45% of travel venture capital funding went to AI-enabled startups in the first half of 2025, up from about 10% in 2023.
sample: Skift venture capital tracking of travel-industry funding
methodology: Skift venture capital tracking, reported in Remapping travel with agentic AI (McKinsey with Skift, September 2025). Share of disclosed travel-industry venture funding.
